svg.title: The launch model lost 17.5% in the round's first 11 days, while BTC lost 4.7%
svg.desc: Line chart of return during the round. Launch model −17.5%, BTC hold −4.7%, 7 other paper bots −5.1% to −21.4%.
svg.text: The launch model lost 17.5% in the round's first 11 days, while BTC lost 4.7%
Paper bots on live Roostoo quotes, rebased to 0% at the round start (Oct 4, 12:00 UTC). Not the competition account.
Source: data/live*/logs, docs/assets/data/paper_round.csv. Logs end Oct 15, 10:00 UTC, three days before the round closed.
